name: single-leg-squat-from-bench
instructions:
1. Set up in a single leg stance position on a bench with one leg bent straight in front of you and the other supporting your bodyweight while keeping the knee slightly bent.
2. Descend by flexing the knee of the supporting leg and continue until your foot touches the floor.
3. Drive through the front foot and extend the knee as you return to the starting position.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
